_status: REAL data, converted by scripts/import_nasa_env.py. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script.
badge: NASA OSDR RadLab: Mars surface (Curiosity RAD)
note: The thin Martian air and the planet itself block part of the radiation, so the surface gets less than deep space.
quantity: Absorbed dose rate (dose in the detector, not the body's effective dose)
unit_source: Not stated in the CSV header. RadLab API docs use '2 uGy/hour' for the filter absorbed_dose_rate>2 (https://visualization.osdr.nasa.gov/radlab/api/), so absorbed_dose_rate is in µGy/h.
filled_note: 55 of 2160 20-minute steps had no reading and were filled by a straight line (gaps up to 2 h).
